obligations.summary: General_Category, Script, Script_Extensions, Bidi_Class, Joining_Type, Indic_Syllabic_Category, and Indic_Positional_Category from the Unicode 18.0.0 UCD, and Grapheme_Cluster_Break, Indic_Conjunct_Break, and Extended_Pictographic.
obligations.engine_behavior: fairpane.unicode.lookup returns all ten properties for every code point from U+0000 to U+10FFFF without allocation and returns error.NotCodePoint above U+10FFFF.

obligations.summary: The sfnt table directory and the head, hhea, maxp, hmtx, loca, glyf header, cmap, name, OS/2, post, CFF, GDEF, GSUB, and GPOS table headers.
obligations.engine_behavior: fairpane.font.parse validates the directory and required tables without allocation, maps code points through cmap formats 4 and 12, returns advances and glyph headers, and reports optional-table defects as TableStatus values. It validates each distinct cmap subtable once and returns error.InvalidCmap for a cmap with more than 512 distinct subtable offsets.

obligations.summary: Every other file of the specs/IMPORT_REQUIREMENTS.md table, including case mapping, normalization, word and sentence segmentation, line breaking, emoji sequences, IDNA, and the conformance test files other than GraphemeBreakTest.txt, and the properties of DerivedCoreProperties.txt and emoji-data.txt other than Indic_Conjunct_Break and Extended_Pictographic.
obligations.engine_behavior: No API. The engine has no Unicode data beyond the ten properties above.

obligations.summary: The Unicode Bidirectional Algorithm (UAX #9) with paired brackets and mirroring.
obligations.engine_behavior: No API. The engine exposes Bidi_Class only and resolves no embedding levels.

obligations.summary: UAX #29 extended grapheme cluster boundaries from Grapheme_Cluster_Break, Indic_Conjunct_Break, and Extended_Pictographic, for caret movement and selection.
obligations.engine_behavior: fairpane.text.GraphemeBoundaries yields the UAX #29 GB1 to GB999 extended grapheme cluster boundaries of a string as UTF-16 code-unit indexes, without allocation and in linear time. Legacy grapheme clusters, tailorings, and random-access boundary queries are not offered.

obligations.summary: Line break opportunities (UAX #14) integrated with inline layout.
GSUB and GPOS lookups, Arabic joining, and Indic and Universal Shaping Engine reordering.
obligations.engine_behavior: No API. GSUB and GPOS expose only their script tags, feature tags, and lookup counts; no lookup runs.

obligations.summary: Per-code-point font selection across a fallback list, including the uncovered-emoji seed.
obligations.engine_behavior: No API. glyphIndex returns 0 for an unmapped code point, and nothing selects another font.

obligations.summary: glyf outline and composite decoding, CFF Type 2 charstrings, and scan conversion.
obligations.engine_behavior: Font.trueTypeGlyph decodes TrueType simple and composite outlines in font units without hinting. It returns error.UnsupportedPhantomPoint for point matching against a phantom point and error.NotTrueType for a CFF font. CFF charstrings are not interpreted, and no scan converter exists.

obligations.summary: A decision on TrueType bytecode and CFF hinting and its implementation.
obligations.engine_behavior: No API. Hinting instructions are never interpreted.
font.parse returns error.UnsupportedWoff for the wOFF signature.

obligations.summary: WOFF2 decoding with a first-party Brotli decoder.
obligations.engine_behavior: font.parse returns error.UnsupportedWoff2 for the wOF2 signature.
font.parse returns error.UnsupportedCollection for the ttcf signature.

obligations.summary: CFF2 outlines, the item variation store, and fvar, avar, gvar, HVAR, and MVAR.
obligations.engine_behavior: font.parse returns error.UnsupportedCff2 for a CFF font with a CFF2 table; variation tables are not read, so a variable font exposes only its default instance.

obligations.summary: COLR, CPAL, sbix, CBDT and CBLC, and SVG glyphs.
obligations.engine_behavior: No API. Color and bitmap tables are not read.
No API. Vertical metric tables are not read.

obligations.summary: cmap format 14 variation sequences and the legacy and symbol cmap formats.
obligations.engine_behavior: Formats 0, 2, 6, 8, 10, 13, and 14 pass only a header and length check, and font.parse returns error.NoUnicodeCmap when no (3, 10) or (0, 4) format 12 or (3, 1) or (0, 3) format 4 subtable exists.
No API. These tables are not read.

obligations.summary: Enumeration of installed fonts through narrow platform adapters.
obligations.engine_behavior: No API. The engine parses only font bytes that its caller supplies.
